title: Top experience. Great guide...Thanks Max
text: An awesome experience that can only be recommended. Max was a great guide and we had a lot of fun and also saw great places that we otherwise would not have seen on foot. Highly recommended!!!!
author: Trek49444280996

title: We had a really fun time...
text: We had a really fun time wizzing around Barcelona.  This is a great way to see the city,  Julio was a brilliant guide. You are riding on the roads in the bike lanes, but following Julio's lead made it very easy. This is a 3 hour tour, but the time flew by. Even though it was really hot, as you are on the move the breeze kept us nice and cool.

title: Great tour and guide
text: Best ever. Max is the best guide ever! He has good English, he is very funny, and such a great guy. The tour itself is breathtaking, you will be amazed by all the views! Would recommend doing it!
author: Ryan C

title: Segway is the best way to see Barcelona.
text: Easy location to find and Max was a great guide. Highly recommend. Max was flexible and knowledgeable.
author: RedSpice

title: Best tour ever
text:
This was fabulous 
I would highly recommend this tour to everyone   We saw so much of Barcelona very small group  just two of us so we zipped along nicely   We were a bit scared when we first got on thinking on man what did we sign up for but within a few minutes of us hopping on we were fairly confident in driving on   The lanes for bikes are busy but we felt safe the whole time   We saw some unbelievably beautiful things   So glad we took this adventure   We are 60 + and it was the best tour I have ever been on
author: Bonnie_E

title: Excellent Tour!
